title: Puzzle2d Brush Tool
description: Implement paint-style Brush tool for puzzle2d: offset slot hitboxes, compatible node preview, auto-flush on leave, Tab cycle candidates, flush-distance window measure.
summary:
Fixed runtime crash in Puzzle2dPlayPaneCanvas: onBrushPlace referenced guardFixtureAuthoringFromStructuralDeletes which only exists inside Puzzle2dPlayInner. Moved brush commit logic into shell context as commitBrushPlacement (200ms quiet window, structural-delete guards, peer sync). Pane canvas now calls commitBrushPlacement from usePuzzle2dPlayShell.

Tests: framework/product/playground/renderer/react 16/16.
